logic.entry: Use lastL completed daily closes includingj. Forx=0..L-1,y=ln(close),fit intercept+slope by OLS. Sxx=sum((x-meanx)^2);beta=sum((x-meanx)*(y-meany))/Sxx;residual_sd=sqrt(sum((y-meany-beta*(x-meanx))^2)/(L-2));score=beta*sqrt(Sxx)/max(residual_sd,1e-12). Constant prices give0; floor handles degenerate perfect fits. Score is dimensionless and is not a calibrated significance test. When flat, enter iff score>entry_t_stat; equality remains cash.
logic.exit: When long, exit iff score<=exit_t_stat=0; otherwise remain long. All estimation uses only completed daily closes; no predictive labels, future observations or fitted hyperparameter selection.
logic.sizing: Independent 2,000 USDT cash account; all original capital allocated to this asset; long-only, no leverage, no borrowing, no cross-asset transfer or add-on.
logic.timing: Close-based signal only from a closed UTC daily bar, next day 00:01 UTC one-minute open (60-second delay); no historical fill before OOS.

parameters.impact_model: 0.5 * sample_stdev(previous 20 complete UTC daily log returns) * sqrt(order quote budget / previous 20 complete daily quote-volume ADV)

sources.scope: Primary definition of OLS slope and residual SD, n-2 degrees of freedom for slope plus intercept.
Slope standard error assumes residual normality. We use only the score formula, no p-values or statistical-significance claims; SciPy is not a runtime dependency.
Official filter definitions; historical filters remain unavailable.
